source: Answers are drawn strictly from verified official MASLOC content. Questions the official site does not answer are answered with the official guidance to contact MASLOC offices — no rates, amounts, timelines or rules have been invented.

items.a: MASLOC — the Microfinance and Small Loans Centre — is a Government of Ghana institution established in 2006. It implements the Government of Ghana's microfinance programmes, providing microcredit and small loans to start-ups and small businesses, and serves as the apex body of the microfinance sub-sector.
MASLOC was established in 2006. Since then it has provided microcredit and small loans to start-ups and small businesses across Ghana.

MASLOC's objective is to provide, manage and regulate on a fiduciary basis approved funds for microfinance and small-scale credit schemes and programmes, and to serve as the apex body of the microfinance sub-sector. It engages directly or indirectly in microcredit and small loans business and promotes a decentralised microfinancial system.
"To provide micro and small loans for start-ups and small businesses with fast, easy and accessible microcredit to grow their businesses, enhancing job and wealth creation."
Professionalism, Integrity, Team Spirit, Excellence and Respect.

MASLOC's published services are: the Microcredit Programme (group lending), Small and Project Loans, the Vehicle and Equipment Hire Purchase Scheme, and wholesale lending to microfinance institutions for on-lending to small businesses. MASLOC also delivers business training and advisory services.

items.q: Who can apply for a microcredit (group) loan?
items.a: Applicants must be organised into a group, association or cooperative of between 5 and 25 members, with a common production or operational interest. Members must be between 18 and 65 years and of sound mind, and the group should have its own leaders — principally a Chairman, Secretary and Treasurer — and internal rules and regulations.

items.q: Who can apply for a small or project loan?
items.a: Applicants must be 18–65 years and of sound mind, with an ongoing business venture or project in which they have sound knowledge and considerable experience. Start-up projects must be viable and capable of generating employment. Individuals, corporate entities, groups, associations and cooperatives may apply.

items.q: Can individuals apply, or only groups?
items.a: Microcredit is a group programme. Small and project loans and the vehicle and equipment hire purchase scheme may be applied for by individuals, corporate entities, groups, associations or cooperatives.

items.q: What interest rates does MASLOC charge?
items.a: Interest rates are not published on MASLOC's official website. Please enquire directly at any MASLOC regional office or the Accra Head Office on +233 302 782527 / +233 302 782528 for current terms.

items.q: How much can I borrow, and for how long?
items.a: Loan amounts and repayment terms are not published on MASLOC's official website. The full range of criteria is available from regional offices or the Accra Head Office.

items.q: Does MASLOC give loans to microfinance institutions?
items.a: Yes. MASLOC provides wholesale lending to microfinance institutions for on-lending to small businesses. Microfinance institutions should contact the Accra Head Office for current wholesale arrangements.

items.q: How do I apply for a MASLOC loan?
items.a: Review the published eligibility criteria for the service you need, prepare your business or group information, then visit your nearest MASLOC regional office or the Accra Head Office. MASLOC publishes that the full range of eligibility criteria and application guidance is available at these offices.
A required-documents checklist is not published on MASLOC's official website. Your regional office will confirm the documents needed for your facility when you apply.

items.q: Is there an online application portal?
items.a: MASLOC does not publish an online application service on its official website. Applications are made through MASLOC regional offices or the Accra Head Office.
29 Third Circular Road, Cantonments, Accra. Telephone: +233 302 782527 / +233 302 782528. Email: info@masloc.gov.gh or enquiries@masloc.gov.gh.

items.q: Does MASLOC have offices outside Accra?
items.a: Yes. MASLOC publishes regional office locations across Ghana — see the Regional Offices directory for addresses and postal codes.
Approval timelines are not published on MASLOC's official website. Please confirm current processing times with your regional office.
